XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
The car is equipped with a service interval indicator located in the multifunction display of the instrument panel.

When one of the services scheduled in the periodic maintenance programme is due, the indicator displays a warning message for the driver.

After performing the maintenance, you can reset the indicator:

Vehicles with less than 200 kilometres, or when the maintenance indicator is reset for the first time

  • Switch on the ignition
  • Press button 1 several times until the total mileage appears in display 2
  • Press and hold button 1 for 5 seconds
  • Turn off the ignition

    Vehicles with less than 200 km, or when resetting the maintenance indicator for the first time

  • Switch on the ignition
  • Press button 1 several times until the total mileage appears in display 2
  • Press and hold the 1 button for 10 seconds
  • The display 2 will show the code CFG1 CFG2 or CFG3
  • Press the 1 button several times to select the desired interval between CFG1 for 30,000 km , CFG2 for 20,000 km , CFG3 for 15,000 km
  • Press and hold the 1 button for at least 10 seconds to confirm the selected interval
  • Switch off the ignition
